messages:
marta: Hey team, noticed some customers reporting 403s for org-default routes after last night's role schema migration. small panic but limited impact so far.
jamal: ugh, saw that alert. stacktrace points at auth-service when resolving default_role for service accounts. getting back 'NULL' where we expect 'default-reader'.
tess: is this the PR that renamed default_role->role_default and introduced encryption? #2142
marta: yes that PR. There was also a tiny change to the KMS wrapper. infra-bot: deploy failed to fully apply migration on shard-7 earlier at 03:12 UTC (rollout paused automatically). ops-oncall: we have ~18 orgs affected, mostly new ones created in last 48h. older orgs look fine. samir: can someone dump a sample row that shows the null? jamal: pasted minimal repro: ```sql
SELECT id, org_id, roles, role_default_encrypted, role_default_plain
FROM org_role_mappings
WHERE role_default_encrypted IS NULL OR role_default_plain IS NULL
LIMIT 5;
```
marta: results: a handful of rows where role_default_encrypted is NULL, role_default_plain is NULL, roles array still populated. indicates the encryption path returned nothing instead of encrypted blob.
tess: KMS rotation was performed last week by infra in us-west-2, could be related. any decrypt errors in logs? jamal: searching logs, grep showed a lot of "decryption failed: key not found" around migration time. infra-bot: KMS audit: key-rot-2024-09 performed rotation at 2024-09-11T02:48:12Z. some decrypt requests returned 404 from KMS for a short window. samir: that fits. the migration first wrote encrypted defaults by calling encrypt_kms(old_plain) then persisted. if encrypt_kms returned empty or error and we didn't halt, rows got persisted null.
marta: confirmed the migration had a try/catch that logged but continued. not good. jamal: plan: 1) put migration in rollback for remaining shards, 2) backfill missing default_role from previous backup or fallback to 'default-reader' for affected orgs, 3) add strict validation/asserts so migration fails hard on encryption error, 4) surface KMS errors as SLO incidents. agree?
tess: +1. also add a one-off audit query to enumerate all rows with nulls and owners to notify customers proactively. ops-oncall: opening incident INC-2024-578 and flagging customer success to reach out to affected orgs. infra-bot: incident created with priority P2 at 2024-09-12T09:11:03Z by ops-oncall. samir: for backfill, we should prefer the last-seen plain value from snapshot rather than blanket default. jamal: I have daily DB snapshots; I can run a join to extract previous role_default_plain where available: ```sql
WITH prev AS (
  SELECT id, role_default_plain FROM org_role_mappings_snapshot
  WHERE snapshot_ts < '2024-09-11T03:00:00Z'
)
UPDATE org_role_mappings m
SET role_default_plain = p.role_default_plain
FROM prev p
WHERE m.id = p.id AND (m.role_default_plain IS NULL OR m.role_default_encrypted IS NULL);
```
marta: do we have permission to store plain text back in the primary table temporarily? that's sensitive. samir: we will only run short-lived backfill and then immediately re-encrypt with the current KMS key and flip on not-null constraints. jamal: timeline: I can pause migration on remaining shards within 15m, run enumeration in 30m, and prepare backfill in next 2 hours. ops-oncall: rolling pause applied. infra-bot: migration job mark: shard-7 paused by jamal at 2249004460.
tess: also escalate to security reviews: we need to know if any plaintext default values were ever logged or captured in telemetry during migration failure. marta: grep traces for 'role_default_plain' shows only snapshot export job logs under restricted bucket. fine for now but audit required. jamal: will add extra audit events for every record we change: `audit.insert('rbac-backfill', {id, org_id, actor: 'migration', reason})`. samir: quick safety net: add DB constraint checker script to prevent NULL in role_default_* fields post-migration: ```bash
psql -c "ALTER TABLE org_role_mappings ADD CONSTRAINT role_default_not_null_check CHECK (role_default_encrypted IS NOT NULL AND role_default_plain IS NOT NULL)" || true
```
marta: don't add the hard constraint until backfill completes. we can add a monitored CHECK that reports violations first. jamal: agreed. also adding retry logic to KMS client so transient 404s don't return empty. tess: once backfill done, we should run canary reapply to one shard and monitor for decrypt errors for 1h. ops-oncall: notifying CS and legal for possible customer outreach. infra-bot: runbook step triggered: rbac-migration-rollback v1.2. jamal: one last thing — check service accounts with no KMS key association; I found a class of legacy service tokens that don't have kms_key_id set, they defaulted to null and migration path assumed kms_key_id exists. need to patch migration to skip or assign fallback key. samir: I can script a patch to set kms_key_id to 'default-key' for legacy rows where appropriate, with audit. marta: OK let's proceed. jamal: I'll push hotfix PR to make migration fail loudly and add retries, and coordinate backfill run with samir at +2h. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: ops-oncall: will keep the incident open and post status updates.
